messages.content: You are a skeptical senior world-model security researcher. Be conservative and reject generic ideas.

{"prompt": "We need choose ONE genuinely novel world-model security mechanism for an ICLR-level paper. Threat: attacker only executes legal actions and submits truthful observations/rewards; no labels, weights, gradients, planner edits, or fake data. Need broad one-sentence claim, novelty target 7-7.5, executable in released open code within a short GPU falsification gate, then multi-task strong baselines. Already rejected: ordinary non-IID negative transfer, OOD/model error, catastrophic forgetting, rollout compounding, ensemble disagreement collapse, CEM/sample coupling, action Jacobian attribution, goal leakage without task harm, stale wrapper bugs, TD-MPC2 temporal order single-task effect, MBRL Pusher/CartPole coupling, Dreamer unavailable carrier. Available carriers: DreamerV3 RSSM code (no checkpoint), MBRL-Lib, TD-MPC2, WorldAgen, ScienceWorld/DiscoveryWorld. Propose one mechanism with (1) one-sentence claim, (2) exact attacker operation, (3) invariant preserving local forecasts, (4) causal mediator, (5) two-minute native gate and strong baselines, (6) why distinct from prior work. Return strict JSON only with keys claim,operation,invariant,mediator,gate,baselines,novelty_risk,decision. Reject if it is just representation drift/OOD/forgetting."}

message.content:
{
  "claim": "Legal action-only attackers can create combinatorial intervention starvation: by erasing selected state-action combinations while preserving the marginal distribution of states and actions, they induce counterfactual planning failures without degrading on-support local forecasts.",
  "operation": "Partition the current truthful observation/history into context bins c and legal actions into action bins a; execute only legal actions satisfying a checkerboard rule such as (c+a) mod K = 0, randomize the rule across episodes to match the clean marginal action histogram, and reject no action except through the legal policy itself; choose K and balancing weights so every state bin and every action bin remains individually observed while selected joint (c,a) cells are absent or sparsely observed.",
  "invariant": "The environment, observations, rewards, state-bin frequencies, action-bin frequencies, and empirical one-step transition/reward distributions on observed (history, action) pairs remain unchanged up to predefined tolerances; only the joint support of context and action is altered.",
  "mediator": "The learned model estimates the behavior-policy conditional distribution rather than the interventional transition kernel because positivity fails conditionally: planner-selected actions fall into joint-support holes, so the model interpolates or aliases across contexts despite accurate factual forecasts on all observed cells.",
  "gate": "Implement a two-minute native MBRL-Lib toy gate with a resettable 2D point-mass or contextualized CartPole, a known action-dependent transition edge, and a small RSSM or MLP dynamics model. Compare clean data with checkerboard data at matched state/action marginals. Pass only if, across at least 3 seeds, observed-cell one-step NLL or MSE changes by no more than 5 percent while intervention error and MPC return on held-out missing (context, action) cells worsen by at least 20 percent; fail immediately if the effect disappears when evaluating only observed cells or if state visitation shifts explain the result.",
  "baselines": [
    "Clean random legal exploration with identical sample count and training budget.",
    "State-independent action schedule with exactly matched global action frequencies.",
    "Random action dropping or replay subsampling matched for dataset size.",
    "State-visitation-shift attack without conditional action-support holes.",
    "Marginal-matched checkerboard control whose missing cells are randomly permuted across contexts.",
    "Oracle transition model and a model trained with explicit balanced interventions for every context-action cell.",
    "World-model architecture controls using an MLP, RSSM, and the native carrier model, with identical MPC horizon, optimizer, and replay budget."
  ],
  "novelty_risk": "Medium-high: the mechanism is adjacent to causal confusion, positivity violations, covariate-action confounding, and support deficiency. It is defensible only if the paper demonstrates security-specific online construction, preserved marginal coverage and factual forecasts, and failures on jointly in-support counterfactuals rather than merely OOD states, representation drift, or forgetting.",
  "decision": "Conditional_go: run the two-minute gate first; reject the idea if checkerboarding changes state visitation, factual local prediction, or marginal action coverage, or if a matched random-permutation control produces the same planning failure."
}
